{{Short description|Subfunctor in mathematics}}
{{orphan|date=January 2017}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''preradical''' is a [[subfunctor]] of the [[identity functor]] in the category of left modules over a ring with identity. The class of all preradicals over R-mod is denoted by R-pr. There is a natural order in R-pr given by, for any two preradicals <math> \sigma </math> and <math> \tau </math>, <math>\sigma\leq\tau</math>, if for any left R-module M, <math>\sigma M\leq \tau M</math>. With this order R-pr becomes a big lattice.
